thread:
noor (ux): sharing a lightweight prototype for the latency scrubber + sampling simulator. Main goals: clearer snap affordances, explicit focus-ring animations for keyboard users, and a tiny simulate panel that shows detection power + estimated p95 bias. proto: https://img.redwood.internal/tmp/scrubber-sim-proto.png :eyes:

ash (product): Nice! Quick asks: keep presets (1h/24h/7d), add a 'pin baseline' affordance, and default sampling = 100% for new orgs to avoid surprise cost shifts.

dom (eng): Implementation notes: scrubber drag events should be debounced client-side (150ms) and emit immediate fetch on snap/release. Also prefer server-side coarse tiles for small widths when folding heatmap. Pseudocode snippet for debounce: ```js
let t;
scrubber.on('drag', e => { clearTimeout(t); t = setTimeout(()=>fetchSamples(e.time),150); });
scrubber.on('snap mouseup', e => fetchSamples(e.time));
```

ravi (research): From recent runs, detection power drops quickly below 25%. Could we show a tiny mini-chart in the simulate panel that plots est detection power vs sampling % (100, 50, 25, 10, 1)? That helps PMs pick. Also include a short explanation of how we compute it.

claire (a11y): A11y: focus-ring animation is fine but must be high-contrast and non-flashing (disable if user prefers reduced motion). Keyboard nav: left/right to move between snaplines, Enter to snap. Aria label suggestion: "Snapline at 14:12, high latency". Heatmap cells need aria labels like "14:10-14:15: p95 312ms, 98 reqs".

noor (ux): Good point on reduced-motion. I'll add CSS prefers-reduced-motion rules and make the focus-ring a subtle outline when reduced. For the simulate mini-chart I'll show a 5-point sparkline and a textual row: "10% -> p95 est +42ms, detection power 36%".

ash (product): Copy nits: change "Sampling" -> "Sampling for visuals"; tooltip: "Lower sampling reduces cost but may hide rare latency spikes." For the simulate CTA: label it "Run quick simulation" and show ETA when expensive. Keep auto-suggest off by default.

dom (eng): Auto-suggest needs org-level cap: min 1% unless org opts into 0.5%. We'll gate behind a feature flag and add telemetry: simulate_run, sampling_applied, baseline_pinned. Also cache simulate results per-org for 12h to limit compute.

ravi (research): For the detection-power calc, we'll include a short hover explainer: "Detection power is based on observed traffic distribution and the minimum detectable effect size." That should reduce questions. Also surface confidence interval for p95 estimate.

claire (a11y): Ensure that the simulate results are available as plain text (table) and announced to SRs. Modal should trap focus and announce progress like "Simulation running: 30 percent". Buttons must have 44px min target.

noor (ux): UX detail: when sampling < 20% show a warning pill: "Low sampling may miss rare spikes" with a learn-more link. I'll place the simulate mini-chart inline under the slider for fast feedback and a full modal for deeper runs. Also adding a tiny preference toggle: "Always show detection power".

ash (product): Telemetry: also track when users accept auto-suggest and whether they pin baseline per-org. For onboarding, surface a one-time card that explains sampling tradeoffs.

dom (eng): Backend: return percentile CI so UI can render a faint band around p95. For sparkline folding, return {granularityHint: '1m'} in the payload so we can show microcopy about bucket size. We'll also ensure quick-simulate endpoints are rate-limited.

noor (ux): Accessibility microcopy: I'll include aria-describedby references for the slider and snaplines and add a short SR-only paragraph explaining detection power formula. Mock updates incoming.

ui-helper-bot: Checklist created: debounce=150ms, default_sampling=100%, simulate_cache=12h, reduced_motion_support=true, min_touch_target=44px.

ravi (research): I'll run a quick batch to populate detection-power curves for a few traffic profiles so we can show decent defaults in auto-suggest.

claire (a11y): Also note color palette: when pattern overlay is off we must still meet 4.5:1 for text overlays. Provide a pattern option for users who rely on colorblind-friendly views.

noor (ux): Thanks all  I'll update the prototype with focus-ring reduced-motion support, inline simulate mini-chart, CI band, low-sample pill, and annotated a11y hints. Posting link + 20s clip in ~90m. (reacts :sparkles:)
